prompt.main_subject: An adult Asian woman in a mature Japanese beauty style wears a minimalist black spaghetti-strap dress and black velvet gloves while presenting an Adam leather bag.
prompt.composition_elements: A 15-second sequence moves from an extreme close-up of the bag logo and fingertips, to a face close-up and side profile, then a medium shot and centered white Adam logo ending.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Dark high-end private lounge with soft bokeh and side backlight outlining the adult woman's silhouette; cinematic texture and natural colors.

technical_specs.camera: Smooth transitions between face close-up and medium shot; slow dolly in and stable tracking.
technical_specs.motion: 0-3s bag-detail stroke; 3-8s head raise and profile turn; 8-12s refined direct gaze; 12-15s fade to logo.

prompt.generated_prompt_string: Subject: an adult Asian woman with clear facial features and stable anatomy, wearing a minimalist black spaghetti-strap dress and black velvet gloves, holding an Adam brand leather bag. From 0-3 seconds, start with an extreme close-up of the metal logo on the bag while her fingertips gently stroke the leather surface to show its texture. From 3-8 seconds, she slowly raises her head, gives a composed direct gaze toward the lens, lets a few hair strands move slightly, and turns from side profile to front. From 8-12 seconds, hold a refined, restrained expression with natural smooth movement. Set the scene in a high-end private lounge with dark soft-light bokeh and side backlight outlining her silhouette. Use smooth switching between face close-up and medium shot, slow dolly in, stable tracking, cinematic texture, rich detail, sharp clarity, natural colors, no blur, and no flicker. From 12-15 seconds, fade out to an artistic white "Adam" logo centered on screen with low, elegant French narration: "Adam, l'élégance éternelle." Keep normal human body structure, stable bag shape, and a steady picture.
prompt.negative_prompt: blurry, low resolution, noise, watermark, unintended text, logo distortion, bag deformation, camera shake, flicker, unstable anatomy, extra fingers, deformed, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, sexual pose
